source_and_donor_lineage.scope: six archetypes, route patterns and specimen references; specimen references are not route membership
canonical Golden Corpus fixture records only
route/archetype identities, semantic regions, states, component refs and viewport tuples
desktop/mobile case ordering only; all Penpot IDs, URLs, screenshots and statuses dropped

package_manifest.materialization_entry_point: D0/MAT or D0/INTEGRATE consumes build_contract.steps in order, binds U0/F0 dependencies by semantic ref, and D0/PUBLISH assigns every new Penpot identity.
explicit_gaps: Specimen fixture bindings never assert production route membership.
A0 supplies semantic regions and viewport tuples, not acceptance-grade component geometry.
D0 must abort on unresolved U0/F0 component, asset, foundation or geometry dependencies.

canonicalization.algorithm: RFC8785-compatible project subset: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted object keys, arrays preserved, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false

pre: target semantic page absent or tagged with exact idempotency digest
all source, donor and dependency hashes match
all semantic region/component refs resolve without legacy identity reuse
post: one semantic page with exact idempotency digest
twelve roots match target.semantic_root_order byte-for-byte and in order
each root reports case, archetype, viewport, specimen-reference policy, state and semantic bindings
all persisted IDs are newly assigned by D0 and absent from this adapter
validation is empty before V0 handoff
